about.title: Beyond the *code*.
paragraphs: I'm Bécaye FALL, a Full Stack developer and tech entrepreneur. I care about the whole chain behind a digital product: from understanding the need to design, development and deployment.
I enjoy exploring technologies, solving complex problems and building solutions that are genuinely useful.
To me, development is not just about writing code. It is about understanding a problem and building the right answer to it.

tabaxbi.name: Tabaxbi
tabaxbi.summary: A collaborative digital platform designed to improve the management and monitoring of construction projects.
tabaxbi.intro: Tabaxbi aims to make collaboration easier between clients, supervisors, companies and suppliers in the construction industry.

problem.title: The problem
problem.text: A construction project brings together many players: clients, supervisors, companies and suppliers. Information can end up scattered, which makes it harder to follow a site and to coordinate everyone involved.

vision.title: The vision
vision.text: Offer a shared space where everyone involved in a construction project can meet, share and follow progress. A platform designed as a product, not just a tool.

solution.title: The solution
solution.text: Tabaxbi brings together networking around projects, site monitoring and information sharing in one collaborative platform, open to every category of stakeholder.

items.name: React + Vite
items.role: Responsive web interface and fast builds.

items.name: JavaScript
items.role: One language across client and server.

items.name: Node.js + Express.js
items.role: REST API and server-side business logic.

architecture.title: General architecture
architecture.text: A client application talks to a REST API. Prisma handles access to PostgreSQL. Everything is containerised with Docker and exposed through Traefik.

perspectives.title: Future directions
items: Deepen progress tracking and make site progress easier to read.
Explore automation and AI to assist document management.

entrepreneurship.title: Think beyond the *product*.
entrepreneurship.statement: A good product is not measured by its code, but by the value it creates for the people who use it. I care as much about that value as about how to build it.
